title: Local source-grounded style example import
target_user: A free/local user who wants to reuse examples from an existing document
observed_problem: The existing uploaded-style workflow fails with the actual mock provider because it requires structured LLM style analysis.

evidence.observation: Document upload always resolves a generation provider and calls analyze_document_style.
The mock response does not satisfy the analyzer's required style fields.
A synthetic TXT probe with the actual MockProvider reproduced a style-analysis ValueError without external calls.

current_workaround: Paste example sentences manually; document upload cannot complete the same no-cost path.
desired_outcome: Import inspectable verbatim document excerpts into a style profile and reuse them in generation without LLM analysis or model training.
acceptance_criteria: A distinct local import route and UI command reuse the non-AI attachment parser and existing StyleStore without invoking provider factories or AI fallback.
TXT, MD, DOCX, HWPX and text-layer PDF inputs yield deterministic bounded source excerpts; unsupported, scanned, empty or malformed inputs never create fabricated examples.
Eight-file batches, existing per-file byte/text caps and eight 1000-character excerpts per file are enforced before persistence.
Current tenant/profile authorization remains intact; partial failures preserve prior examples and tone guides.
Real local import, reload and selected-style generation tests prove persisted excerpts reach the prompt and affect style cache identity.
Single-flight and stale auth/profile response guards prevent misleading UI results; no automatic retry duplicates an uncertain import.
affected_boundaries: Style router and focused local extraction service
Existing StyleStore and non-AI attachment parsers
Style browser actions and local/API/browser tests

allowed_effects: Persist source-grounded style examples in local/fake-S3 verification
Reuse saved examples in the existing mock generation prompt
excluded_effects: Fabricate analysis or change model weights
Modify other tenants or existing tone guides
Commit, push, install or modify credentials
separate_approval_required_for: Provider calls, dataset upload or training

local_verification.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_local_style_example_import.py tests/test_local_style_import_ui.py tests/test_generation_style_selection.py tests/test_style_system.py
local_verification.proves: Source-grounded local import, reload, generation prompt and existing style regression checks; exact run evidence and isolated environment are recorded in the implementation spec.

decision.rationale: The repository operator approved this exact local import implementation and verification scope in the current conversation. External effects remain excluded.
